testsuite.name: UC12 HCP Edit Demographics
testsuite.details: Test suite automatically generated from CLARET specifications (UFCG)

testcase.name: TC1 - Basic Flow (Happy Path)
testcase.preconditions: An HCP is a registered user of the iTrust2 system (UC1). The HCP has authenticated in the system (UC2).

step.actions: patient: The HCP selects a patient to edit from the list of patients. The selected patient's current demographics fill the form. The HCP makes any desired edits and press the Submit button. If they select a different patient after editing, but before submitting, a warning is shown .
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM A message shows if the data entered is valid .

testcase.name: TC2 - Exception Flow 1: Invalid data entered
testcase.preconditions: An HCP is a registered user of the iTrust2 system (UC1). The HCP has authenticated in the system (UC2).

step.actions: patient: The HCP selects a patient to edit from the list of patients. The selected patient's current demographics fill the form. The HCP makes any desired edits and press the Submit button. If they select a different patient after editing, but before submitting, a warning is shown .
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM identifies fields that are incorrect or invalid, and prompts the HCP to correct them. The data must match the requirements specified in [Section 4.6](https://github.ncsu.edu/engr-csc326-staff/iTrust2-v1/wiki/uc4#46-data-format).

testcase.name: TC3 - Exception Flow 2: Unsaved changes warning
testcase.preconditions: An HCP is a registered user of the iTrust2 system (UC1). The HCP has authenticated in the system (UC2).

step.actions: patient: The HCP selects a patient to edit from the list of patients. The selected patient's current demographics fill the form. The HCP makes any desired edits and press the Submit button. If they select a different patient after editing, but before submitting, a warning is shown .
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM prompts that A warning is shown about unsaved changes that will be lost. If they repeat the action, the new patient's data is loaded .
